title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Currently, our offer stands at a price of €5.99 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months, no Preisgleitklausel. 

As an alternative at our standard terms, we can offer a price of €5.92 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, no Preisgleitklausel. To offer you this improved price of €5.92, we must maintain our standard 30-day payment terms, as 90 days would necessitate a higher unit price. 

Please note that a binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? For your planning, our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Please keep in mind that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: 1.4404 bar part:370010 – 24-month volume commitment and price basis
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for the revised offer. To answer your question: we can commit 94,800 kg per year over a 24-month contract, or 36 months if that helps you more.

AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.
PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

You also told us that your alloy needs are covered at fixed prices until March 2027. We therefore propose a fixed price without an index clause; see the attached packages.

Could you also suggest any cheaper variant, for example a different bar condition or call-off pattern?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: 1.4404 bar part:370010 – 24-month volume commitment and price basis
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. However, we also checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

We appreciate your 24-month volume commitment, which allows us to significantly reduce our price to €5.48 per unit. Because we cannot offer a fixed price for a 24-month duration, we must include an AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term material risks. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.48 per unit. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

Our main proposal stands at a price of €5.36 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We also present an alternative package at a price of €5.48 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: 1.4404 bar part:370010 - packages with index clause and deadband
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for moving to 24 months. We accept that you need an index clause and have built two of our three packages around it. Each covers 94,800 kg per year at 90 days net.

Your alloy is fixed-priced until March 2027, so the first months of the contract carry no alloy risk for you. A deadband shares later movements fairly in both directions.

We can also commit 36 months, so your volume is secured beyond your hedge.

If these levels exceed your authority, could you arrange a pricing review with your owner? He offered in April to walk us through your calculation.

Which package works best for you?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: 1.4404 bar part:370010 - packages with index clause and deadband
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your continued engagement with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. We always value our partnership and the opportunity to support your ongoing requirements from our extensive range.

We have reviewed your packages, but as your proposed price levels have not improved, we must maintain our offer of €5.36 per unit. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Regarding our calculation, material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Additionally, please provide the correspondence from April where our owner offered to walk you through our calculation, as we have no record of this.

Our Angebot comprises a price of €5.36 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: 1.4404 bar part:370010 - packages with index clause and deadband

We regret that we could not agree and remain at your disposal. 

As a distributor, we always value your business and hope to support your team again soon with our high-quality range and service. Please feel free to reach out to us whenever new requirements arise.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
